thread:
zoe-finance: Heads up — invoice from SWI Consulting (Lucas) for Redwood EU S.à r.l. landed. Vendor has a 15% WHT line, missing VAT ID, and is asking us to gross-up. Holding payment until we get docs.

marc-legal: Who's the billing entity? LU vs US changes treaty application. Also need the vendor's Certificate of Fiscal Residence (CFR) before any treaty relief.

procure-bot: PO #4567 covers this SOW. Note: any gross-up will require a PO amendment and approvals.

lucas-vendor: Hi all 12; Lucas from SWI. We can send CFR and either a net invoice with WHT shown or a grossed-up invoice. Swiss tax advisor flagged 15% when billing LU. Which do you prefer?

tax-bot: FYI: W-8/W-9 are US-specific. For Swiss suppliers billing a Luxembourg entity we need CFR and may need Luxembourg source documentation to apply treaty/reduced rates.

zoe-finance: Requesting CFR + updated invoice that shows gross amount, WHT line, net due, and vendor bank details. Will not release payment until CFR received.

marc-legal: I'll review the Luxembourg




-Switzerland DTA and confirm whether the service falls into a zero/reduced withholding category.

procure-bot: If vendor insists on gross-up, flagging budget impact: need procurement + finance signoff. If gross-up > 5k EUR get exec approval.

lucas-vendor: CFR and invoice v3 sent to finance@redwood.com (attached). Invoice shows: "Service fee 25,000 EUR 









- Withholding 3,750 EUR (15%) - Net due 21,250 EUR". Also added a line: "Vendor requests gross-up".

zoe-finance: Received attachments. Opening PO amendment request and pinging @head-of-procure. Forwarding CFR to tax for validation.

tax-bot: Note logged: CFR received. Next: legal to confirm treaty article and whether Luxembourg requires any further attestation to apply reduced rate.

marc-legal: Quick update: DTA text suggests business profits are taxed in resident state unless permanent establishment in LU. For standalone consultancy services, LU domestic WHT may still apply; escalating to external counsel for final word.

zoe-finance: OK thanks. We will either apply treaty rate/credit if confirmed or withhold at domestic rate and remit. Holding payment until legal confirms or PO change completes. :handshake:

procure-bot: Reminder: ensure vendor bank details + tax reg number in invoice for AP processing.

lucas-vendor: Thanks. Will add bank details and vendor tax number if missing. Appreciate quick turnaround.

tax-bot: Thread checklist added: [CFR, updated invoice with WHT lines, vendor bank details, legal DTA confirmation].
